title: 招聘动态汇总：Stillfront、SciPlay、Scopely、King、Zynga、Playtika 等公司高层变动
content:
Jobs digest: big moves at Stillfront, SciPlay, Scopely, King, Zynga, Playtika, Dream and more – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Our jobs digest has all the recruitment news you need from across the mobile games business, all in one spot.
This column is sponsored by
FastSpring
.
FastSpring
: Global payments for your games from a partner you can trust with your players. Quickly launch a new web store, replace an existing D2C vendor, or add a redundant vendor at
fastspring.gg
.
Stillfront
:
Adam Schaub
has joined Stillfront as group chief operating officer, based in Stockholm and reporting to CEO Marcus Jacobs. The pair co-founded Cult of the North together in 2022, and Schaub was previously studio general manager at EA, VP of creative production at King and VP of Europe at Mythical Games. Jacobs
took over as Stillfront CEO
earlier this month.
Stillfront’s Adam Schaub, SciPlay’s Matthieu Labbat, Scopely’s Saksham Rattan, King’s Carlos Person and Zynga’s Shayer Waseem Shaik.
SciPlay
: Light & Wonder has named
Matthieu Labbat
as CEO of its social casino business SciPlay. Labbat spent seven and a half years at Aristocrat’s Product Madness, most recently as SVP and head of the company, and previously held product and business performance roles at King. He replaces Josh Wilson, whose
departure was announced
in September.
Scopely
: New associate product manager
Saksham Rattan
starts at Scopely after nine months as a senior QA at EA.
King
: Barcelona’s Catalog Games team at King has a new senior principal Unity developer in
Carlos Person
, who joins from Appodeal, where he spent a year as head of development.
Zynga
: Slots specialist
Shayer Waseem Shaik
is Zynga’s new game design director. He spent the last two years as head of design at Light & Wonder.
Playtika’s Joseph Moore, Dream Games’ Sude Bay and Moonton’s Görkem Mansız, plus Voodoo’s Elif Ece Küskü and Kieran Finlayson.
Playtika
: After almost four years at Ainsworth Game Technology, most recently as studio manager and senior game designer,
Joseph Moore
is now a producer and manager at Playtika.
Dream Games
: Royal Match maker Dream Games has hired
Sude Bay
as a product specialist following spells at Diageo and Mastercard.
Moonton
: Former Wargaming staffer
Görkem Mansız
has joined Mobile Legends: Bang Bang developer Moonton as a senior creative designer.
Voodoo
: Two new starters at Voodoo:
Elif Ece Küskü
joins as a publishing manager after a year as a game manager at Rollic, and
Kieran Finlayson
joins as the new senior level designer on Hole.io, after
almost five years at Moon Active as a game lead and level designer.
GameHouse
:
Emmi Kuusikko
is leaving GameHouse, and the games industry, after four years as head of product, where she built female-focused subscription service GameHouse+. Kuusikko previously spent time at Sulake, Digital Chocolate, Lionhead Studios and Next Games, where she was chief product officer, and co-founded gamified app startup Carrot Kitchen. She said she’s “staying in tech” and will share more soon.
GameHouse’s Emmi Kuusikko, Tripledot’s Aylin Yazıcı, Belka Games’ Anastasiya Kara, Ten Square Games’ João Silva and SuperPlay’s Amit Raubach.
Tripledot
: Over at Tripledot’s Lion Studios,
Aylin Yazıcı
starts a new role in market intelligence. She spent the previous ten months as a mobile games consultant, editor and writer at Deconstructor of Fun.
Belka Games
: Ex-Rovio
Anastasiya Kara
is Belka Games’ new product director for casual. She was at Rovio for almost two years, most recently as LiveOps and features lead.
Ten Square Games
:
João Silva
takes on the role of lead ad monetisation product manager at Ten Square Games, having previously spent four years as ad monetisation lead at Miniclip.
SuperPlay
: Dice Dreams maker SuperPlay has promoted
Amit Raubach
to monetisation manager, after one year and nine months as QA operations manager.
Stash
: Helsinki-based
Katharina Schmidt
is D2C payments firm Stash’s new associate director of business development. She joins after more than four years at Rovio, where she was senior manager and head of business development.
